orcaInp.studio.spectraGlobs.description: Globs (relative to each workspace folder) of NEA spectrum files listed in the Studio Spectra tab: columns x, total[, CI low, CI high, S1..SN] as written by PyNEAppLES.

orcaInp.studio.experimentGlobs.description: Globs of experimental two-column spectra (x, y; whitespace, tab, comma or semicolon separated), drawn dashed in the Studio Spectra tab. Any file can also be added with "Add files…" and toggled to experiment.

orcaInp.studio.spectrumNamePattern.description: Regular expression applied to spectrum file stems in the Studio Spectra tab; every named group becomes a filterable column of the library (e.g. wigner-augccpVDZ_adc3-augccpVDZ_n1000 → sampling, geometry, method, basis, n).

notes: Redirect orcaInp.previewSpectrum to the Spectra tab: for a file URI (a .out, or any spectrum .dat/.txt) call openStudio(extensionUri, 'spectra', { files: [uri.fsPath] }); for a folder URI (folder of per-geometry .out files, or a folder holding geom_NNNN/result.json sets directly, in <folder>/geoms or <folder>/<label>/geoms) call openStudio(extensionUri, 'spectra', { folder: uri.fsPath }). With no URI, use the active editor's file as { files: [path] }. The tab adds the paths to its library (persisted), selects them and plots them: a .out becomes a stick spectrum broadened with orcaInp.spectrum.singleGeometryBandwidth, a folder an NEA average with the Silverman bandwidth, both as absolute σ(E) in cm² molecule⁻¹. The tab covers everything spectrumPanel.ts shows (sticks, broadening, h slider, nm/eV axis, band descriptors) plus the multi-set result.json case without a quick pick (every set becomes a library entry), so spectrumPanel.ts's showSpectrumPreview/spectrumHtml/nonce can be deleted once the command is redirected. Check first that nothing else imports nonce() from spectrumPanel.ts (grep), and keep orcaInp.spectrum.singleGeometryBandwidth: the tab reads it. The command also needs no quick pick any more. Follow-up for the orchestrator: HostContext.pickFiles results cannot be verified by tab hosts, so the tab accepts outside-workspace paths only when they are folders or have a spectrum/output extension (.dat .txt .csv .tsv .xy .out); see the report.
